title: endpoint.json
description: PluginData/endpoint.json, written by the host while it runs so clients can find the port and token.

hostVersion.description: Version of the Skizzy host plugin.

host.description: Loopback address the host listens on.

port.description: TCP port the host listens on.

pid.description: Process id of the KSP process (0 if unknown).

startedUtc.description: UTC ISO 8601 time the host started.

tokenFile.description: Name of the token file next to endpoint.json; send its content as a Bearer token.
